info.title: Meerko API
info.description: Everything the Meerko dashboard, CLI and MCP server do, over HTTP: they are clients of this same API. Authenticate with an API key from Connections → API keys (`Authorization: Bearer mk_…`).

bearer.description: An API key (mk_…) or an OAuth access token (mo_…)

score.description: 0-100; null without an ICP or data to compare
